Innovation that meets the world’s growing food, fuel, fiber and transportation needs with sustainable technology.
Innovating and expanding our world's potential.
Providing advanced irrigation, infrastructure, and industrial technology solutions that benefit us all.

We know every drop—and every minute—matters. That’s why our irrigation solutions are built for growers who demand reliable performance. From durable Zimmatic pivots to smart, easy-to-use FieldNET water management technology, we help you increase yields, save time, and get more from every acre. With responsive support from trusted local dealers and a full lineup of innovative products, Lindsay is here to help you grow stronger—season after season.

We’re shaping the future of transportation with innovative safety solutions and integrated systems that protect drivers, road workers, and entire communities. From advanced crash cushions and barrier systems to intelligent traffic management and remote asset monitoring, our infrastructure solutions are engineered to meet the evolving needs of today’s roadways. Whether you’re planning a major highway project, managing a busy work zone, or installing lifesaving hardware, we’re committed to helping you keep traffic moving—safely, efficiently, and sustainably.
See how our products are transforming farms and roadways across the globe.

At Lindsay, real-world results speak volumes. Lindsay’s case studies highlight real success across both irrigation and infrastructure. From boosting crop yields with precision technology to improving road safety and traffic flow, these stories show how our solutions deliver measurable results. Each case reflects our commitment to innovation, performance, and helping customers build more efficient, sustainable operations.

pages.raw_title: About Lindsay Corporation | Our Company Vision & Values
pages.raw_meta: Learn how Lindsay advances irrigation, infrastructure and tech through innovation, values and a commitment to progress.
raw_blocks: Find a Dealer or Sales Rep
Find a Dealer Find a Sales Rep

Lindsay prides itself on innovating state-of-the-art technology, manufacturing dependable products, and cultivating genuine partnerships with our customers and each other. Our purpose is simple—to conserve natural resources, expand our world’s potential, and enhance the quality of life for people. Since 1955, we’ve led in the development of innovative products that save time and deliver peace of mind—because real progress isn’t just about technology; it’s about making a tangible difference in people’s lives.
Boldly powering change. Bravely creating opportunity.

Our vision is to be the innovation and market leader in our core segments, including irrigation and infrastructure equipment and technology. We are at the forefront of research and development of sustainable solutions to meet the food, fuel, fiber, and transportation needs of the world’s rapidly growing population.
A global leader with small town values.

At Lindsay, we are committed to building relationships with customers and each other. Headquartered in the Midwest, our values guide us as we innovate customer-first solutions that address the complex challenges of agriculture, infrastructure, and technology. Our global footprint is driven by our commitment to fostering personal connections and maintaining reliability and trustworthiness.

We’re driven by our core values of safety, quality, integrity, collaboration, and creativity. Through trusted long-lasting relationships, innovative, dependable products, and truly caring support, we help make our customers’ work and lives easier, safer, and more fulfilling so the world can keep progressing. Together.
The people who make progress possible.

Lindsay is driven by a team of more than 1,300 hardworking individuals across the globe who are united by pride and passion for our work. We’re proud to foster an inclusive workplace where individual talents are respected and career development is encouraged, no matter where you start. And our team members’ safety is our top priority. We want to ensure every person returns home safely every night.
Are you ready to help us preserve natural resources, feed the global population, and improve road safety? See our careers .
Solving global challenges from agriculture to road safety.

For over 50 years, Lindsay has been a global leader in irrigation and infrastructure. Every day we’re expanding the potential of operations around the world to create a safer, more sustainable future for us all.
